name: Jacob Rutland
original_name: ジェイコブ ラトランド
source:
It appears that Jacob knows more about the secrets of Shironagasu Island than he's letting on. Although he will give detective [url=/c95244]Ikeda[/url] some information, he only gives him half the story.

Jacob is a functioning alcoholic with a penchant for expensive wines.

[From [url=https://tabinomichi.jp/shironagasu/en/]official website[/url]]
